item.description: The Co. Cavan man appointed as the editor of the Irish Farmers’ Journal said he is “privileged and excited” about taking on the new role. item.title: Site selected for domestic violence refuge in Monaghan
item.description: A suitable location has now been identified in Monaghan for a 12-unit refuge. Safe Ireland confirmed the news in response to a Parliamentary Question put forward by Cavan-Monaghan TD Brendan Smith. The exact location has not been put in the public domain as of yet according to Deputy Smith. item.title: Former Monaghan Garda on his cancer experience
item.description: A former Garda, who served for many years in Monaghan is sharing his story for oesophageal Cancer Awareness Month. Paul Hargadon served as a member of An Garda Siochana for 35 years, and spent many of those working in Monaghan. He retired in 2010 and was the the Chief Superintendent of the Roscommon - Longford Garda division. item.title: New mural recently completed in Monaghan Town
item.description: A new mural has been completed in Monaghan Town in recent weeks. Entitled 'Pocketful of Industry' by Friz is inspired by a 1980s photograph from the Montex Jeans factory in Monaghan town. The mural celebrates the entrepreneurial spirit and rich industrial heritage that helped shape Monaghan. Advertisement This project is proudly funded by Creative Monaghan through Creativeirl. item.title: People are livid over lack of progress for Virginia Bypass plans
item.description: Local representatives have vowed to do everything they can to get progress made on the Virginia Bypass. Frustration was voiced by various councillors at the meeting of Cavan County Council this week when was announced that the Virginia Bypass is not be expected to go to planning until Q4 2027. The announcement followed a motion raised by TP O’Reilly seeking an update on the progression of the Virginia Bypass to planning stage proposed for early 2026. item.title: Local councillor on need for e-scooter regulations
item.description: A local councillor is calling for Cavan County Council to support the government's plans to regulate e-scooters. Cllr Niamh Brady acknowledged that e-scooters can offer a convenient and environmentally friendly mode of transport. However, she added that she has received a number of calls from local people outlining serious safety concerns with the use of e-scooters, particularly when they are used on footpaths. item.title: Only one local garda appointed to Roads Policing Unit last year
item.description: An Garda Síochána has missed its roads policing staff targets for the second year in a row. That's despite an increase in road deaths last year compared with 2024. Only one RPU (Roads Policing Unit) member was appointed to Co Cavan, while Co Monaghan received no allocations in 2025. Advertisement Gardaí only allocated 56 members to roads policing duties last year - despite needing 127 to fulfil commitments. item.title: Investigation launched over alleged Ballyconnell assault
item.description: Gardai are investigating an alleged assault over the weekend in Ballyconnell. On Sunday morning shortly after 1am, gardaí responded to reports of an assault on Main Street in the town. A man in his 20s was treated at the scene and was subsequently taken by ambulance to Cavan Hospital. Advertisement It’s understood the alleged victim was set upon as he walked along the street. Gardai say no arrests have been made to date and investigations are ongoing.
